decisions.decision: The solver returns three verdicts (FEASIBLE, INFEASIBLE, UNDERDETERMINED), never two.
decisions.rationale: Collapsing UNDERDETERMINED into INFEASIBLE discards viable modules on absent evidence and silently suppresses the contract defect. Collapsing it into FEASIBLE fabricates compatibility — the failure a green build never catches.
decisions.falsifier: A real composition corpus where UNDERDETERMINED never distinguishes a case that INFEASIBLE would have handled correctly.

decisions.decision: 22 rules evaluate in a fixed total order across 7 phases; the FIRST failing rule names the verdict.
decisions.rationale: The named constraint selects the next gate. An unordered solver picking 'the worst' failure requires a severity ranking, which is a judgement call — exactly what a deterministic solver must not contain.
decisions.falsifier: Operators consistently need a constraint other than the first-failing one to plan the next action.

decisions.decision: migration_owner is a SEPARATE constraint from namespace.
decisions.rationale: namespace catches COLLISION (two modules naming one object; fix = rename/reshape). migration_owner catches contested AUTHORITY over an object both legitimately touch (fix = a human product decision). Same symptom, different disease, different gate. Folding them is the most plausible simplification available and it is wrong.
decisions.source: P04 C6 (E) — the only composition rule proved by OPERATING it (SISOCRM Prisma/Teable vs Django/Plane); INV-P09-1 (E)
decisions.falsifier: No real composition distinguishes the two; then merge and simplify the table.

decisions.decision: One migration owner per RESOURCE, not per composition.
decisions.rationale: CF-01 has two legitimate migration owners (donor_upstream for an intact service, actionist_single_owner for absorbed/owned code) and no contested resource. A solver enforcing one owner per COMPOSITION would reject it and make heterogeneous reuse impossible — defeating the Actionist thesis.
decisions.falsifier: A pilot workflow that cannot be expressed without two writers on one resource.

decisions.decision: Candidate ranking is min-gated on the weakest evidence family, never a weighted average.
decisions.rationale: A weighted score is DESIGNED to let strength in one dimension compensate for weakness in another. For a capability entering a client's production system that is catastrophic: excellent adaptation cost plus unresolved rights must not outrank clean rights.
decisions.source: I-P15-2 (E) — a deliberate divergence from the entire external recommender census; P14 C6 (E)
decisions.falsifier: F-P12-05: weighted scoring selects better assets in a paired comparison.

decisions.decision: The composer consumes exactly five ProductSpec field groups; everything else is for humans, acceptance and learning.
decisions.rationale: Closes P02's explicit deferral: 'The minimum cannot be closed until S2-L4 defines what the composer consumes.' Consumed: requirements[].atom, requirements[].authority, requirements[].coverage, entities[], and the session ladders (authority_ceiling, data_mode, non_goals).
decisions.falsifier: F-P12-07: a composition needs a sixth field.

decisions.decision: The composer refuses to plan against a spec with open_markers > 0 or uncovered_requirements > 0, absent a recorded waiver_ref. It never resolves a marker itself.
decisions.rationale: P02's own A4 names the failure: marker count falling because the model got confident rather than because ambiguity was resolved. A composer that clears markers is that failure.
decisions.falsifier: Gate proves ceremonial — near-100% waiver rate.

decisions.decision: Nine constraints are added to Phase 8's ten: identity, navigation, migration_owner, tenancy, rollback, host_version, glue_budget, observability_identity, evidence_tier.
decisions.rationale: Each names a failure the original ten could not. Every one traces to a specific Sprint 1 packet that proved the failure rather than hypothesised it.
decisions.falsifier: A constraint that never fires distinctly across a real corpus is redundant and should be merged.

decisions.decision: The solver may never relax a constraint; relaxations_applied is const 0.
decisions.rationale: A solver that degrades gracefully by dropping a constraint is indistinguishable from a broken solver, and makes every downstream eval result uninterpretable. Relaxation is a human decision recorded as an approval event.
decisions.falsifier: None expected; this is definitional. Violation voids the plan.

decisions.decision: Glue-budget overflow with exceeded_action=escalate_human_review yields FEASIBLE with feasibility_class=determined_with_human_gate, NOT a refusal.
decisions.rationale: Treating every overflow as a refusal makes escalate_human_review dead config. But feasible-with-a-gate must never read as promotable — hence a distinct feasibility_class rather than a bare FEASIBLE.
decisions.falsifier: CF-21: a solver that cannot distinguish the two states.

decisions.decision: Glue budget must be priced PER COST CLASS (cosmetic / boundary / architectural), not as one changed-lines ceiling. Recorded as an OWED REVISION to R-GLUE, not yet applied.
decisions.rationale: S2-L1's normalization taxonomy (28 surgeries / 14 categories, split 3 cosmetic / 13 boundary / 12 architectural) operationalises the master synthesis distinction: replacing a logo is trivial, replacing migration authority is not. A single line-count ceiling cannot tell them apart.
decisions.why_not_applied_now: Changing a rule after the dry run executed against it would leave the traces describing a table that no longer exists. The dry run's value is that it was executed against the table as written.
decisions.falsifier: F-P12-06: overflow does not correlate with reuse-shape errors once priced per class.

invariants_enforced_not_authored.statement: One authoritative owner per stateful resource
Models cannot grant themselves data, tenant or side-effect authority
Every release pins exact capability and binding versions
Every production composition has a recovery path
Evidence tier is the minimum across families, never an average
Composition authority is the intersection, never the union

rejected_here.why: Unfalsifiable; produces identical output whether contracts were complete or empty. The solver returns UNDERDETERMINED naming the missing field.
Discards viable modules or fabricates compatibility.
Would reject the reference mixed-shape fixture and make heterogeneous reuse impossible.
Sends contested authority to a rename gate; renaming solves nothing.
Averages fatal unknowns (rights, tenancy) into good scores.
P04 C4: the natural implementation is exactly where privilege escalation occurs.

rejected_here.rejected: Adopt a connector catalogue together with its connection store
rejected_here.why: A26 rejected; OpenConnector proved the tenancy failure by demonstration, not inference.

rejected_here.rejected: Popularity/star metadata as a ranking input
rejected_here.why: A22 unproven/weak; stars did not predict adaptation quality in any measured way.

rejected_here.rejected: Negotiated multi-agent composition for the first pilot
rejected_here.why: Adds coordination failure modes on top of composition failure modes before the base case is proven.
Explicitly prohibited by the Sprint 2 program; the strongest evidence was consumed instead.

open_decisions.question: How do P04's authority_class and the Phase 8 session authority ladder compose?
open_decisions.note: S2-L1 owns authority_class; Phase 8 owned the session ladder; NEITHER owns the join. This lane proposes an explicit mapping table with a stated asymmetry (port-level external_effect is authoritative over the class summary) and flags it as the most likely site of a silent privilege bug in the design.

open_decisions.question: What are the calibrated glue-budget thresholds per cost class?
open_decisions.note: A07 ('adaptation is always only 1-2% of the work') is explicitly unknown. The budget is a mechanism with uncalibrated numbers, and this lane declines to invent figures.

open_decisions.question: Can any real module populate the fields these rules read?
open_decisions.note: Zero admitted modules exist. F-C06 stands: the strategy cannot be piloted end-to-end. This is a supply dependency, not an agent defect.

open_decisions.question: Does the ordering of phases survive contact with operator practice?
open_decisions.note: If operators need secondary failures alongside the named constraint, checks_run[] is the channel — not a change to which constraint names the verdict.

contradictions_held_open.statement: The composition architecture requires admitted modules; zero exist.
Absorption (one schema, real FKs) and federation (schemas + read models) pull the data plane in opposite directions; both are locally proven.
contradictions_held_open.resolution: Chosen per capability by PackagingProfile; the composer prices both. CF-01 exists to prove it can.

contradictions_held_open.statement: host_rendered donor settings is a research bet, not an engineering estimate.
contradictions_held_open.source: P10: after 33 commercial surfaces, ZERO render a third party's settings inside host-owned chrome (E). v1 default is donor_rendered_behind_host_nav.

contradictions_held_open.statement: The eval suite cannot be run: tiers A/B need a registry and the registry is empty.

self_inflicted_defect_found_and_fixed.defect: As first drafted, 'minimum across families' was undecidable when two modules report DIFFERENT receipt family sets. The permissive reading (minimum over REPORTED families) would let a module raise its tier by reporting FEWER families — inverting the anti-averaging rule the check exists to enforce.
self_inflicted_defect_found_and_fixed.found_by: hand execution of Trace A in solver-dry-run.md
self_inflicted_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: A required family absent from families_reported is treated as not_run, yielding UNDERDETERMINED naming that family. Never a pass, never omitted from the minimum.
self_inflicted_defect_found_and_fixed.why_recorded: A rule table quietly repaired reads as though it was correct when written. The next reader should know which rules have been executed even once.

counts_corrected_during_smoke.note: Recorded because this project's evidence standard requires re-running counts from source immediately before quoting them.

counts_corrected_during_smoke.rule_count: declared 19 rules; recomputed to 22 rules resolving to 19 DISTINCT constraint names (R-PORTCLOSE/R-PORTTYPE share port_closure; R-AUTHORITY/R-CONSENT share authority; R-ROLLBACK/R-HORIZON share rollback).

feeds_experiments.name: Contract sufficiency dry run on three real shelf modules
feeds_experiments.description: Encode three real P03 shelf modules into the S2-L1 contract family, then hand-execute the 22 rules against them.
feeds_experiments.why_this_is_the_smallest_next_step: Needs no model, no execution environment, no admission and no client. Every UNDERDETERMINED it produces is a concrete contract-field bug report.
feeds_experiments.stop_rule: If >30% of checks return UNDERDETERMINED (K5), fix the contract family rather than building a solver.

feeds_experiments.name: Authority-axis composition check
feeds_experiments.description: Take ten capability shapes and attempt to derive the correct session ceiling from authority_class plus port external_effect alone.

feeds_experiments.name: Determinism repeat run
feeds_experiments.description: Execute the fixture suite three times against a byte-identical input_digest, including the tie case.
feeds_experiments.stop_rule: K6 — any divergence makes every other result uninterpretable.
